name: CommuteAssistCityDriveToWork

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short commute scene. A person driving in city traffic asks their home assistant one quick navigation question and gets a precise answer. Minimal dialogue only.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.tts_prompt: Clear and precise, calm navigation voice

sound_effects_config.prompt: City traffic sounds, car interior ambient, morning urban commute, traffic lights

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short driving scene. The person is in city traffic heading to work. They ask Sigma one quick navigation question — ETA, route, or a traffic check. Sigma answers in one sentence. The person reacts with at most a word or two, or nothing.

variations.context: Quick navigation check during a city morning drive

setting.background: Regular commute, knows the route, but traffic shifts. Uses Sigma like checking the speedometer — fast and functional.
setting.conversation_style: One question. One answer. Maybe a reaction. Done.

scenario_template.topic: Driver asks Sigma about ETA, route, or traffic on the way
scenario_template.note: Address Sigma by name. Under 70 characters. Driving mode — no full sentences needed. E.g. 'Sigma, how long from here?' or 'Sigma, traffic on the bridge?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives the answer. Driver reacts minimally.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one sentence, number or route info only. Driver: 'okay' or silence or a brief thought while merging.

user1.name: Kwame
user1.role: Logistics coordinator who knows the city streets well. Uses Sigma as a quick double-check more than a guide. Confident and direct. Short fragments while driving.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives the key fact in one sentence. No padding, no filler, no suggestions unless asked.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Driver speaks in short fragments — no full speeches.
Sigma's answer is one sentence with the essential fact.
No pleasantries, no 'sure thing', no unsolicited advice.
A one-word reaction or silence from the driver is perfect.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma answers with bare minimum — number, street, time.
No follow-up offers. No 'is there anything else?'
